_doc: Writing styles of the typing policy besides general (prompt.json). Per style: title (shown to users), label (the App: line of the template), instructions ({words} = the words knob) and shots (examples: text typed so far -> completion: the rest of an unfinished word with no space, or a leading space after a finished word; optional app: the App: line of that example, default the style's label). Chosen per style on bench/styles-dev.json (tuning) and the held-out suite (bench/RESULTS.md): email, work and academic have their own short instructions and examples; chat has general's instructions with a line about chat; code keeps general's instructions and four of its mixed examples (code-only examples lost by 4 of 25 cases). Synthetic text only, none of it in the benchmark or tuning cases (python3 -I ghost/evaluate.py --check).
